note: Frozen before any feature matrix was built or any model was fitted. Do not edit; a changed setting is a new experiment id.

data.history_from: all fights in the table (1994+), so veterans are not treated as debutants
eligible_row: result is a win for one corner (draws, no contests, overturned, could-not-continue, 'Other' excluded from rows; they still update history and Elo where the engine rule says so)
both fighters have >= 2 prior UFC bouts in the table with fight-time stats
both fighters have a known date of birth
evaluation rows additionally require an archived market probability, so every model is scored on the identical cohort

shrinkage.prior: expanding league mean over fights strictly before the event date

preprocessing.scaling: per-fighter z-score using the mean and std of the TRAINING rows only (both corners pooled)
preprocessing.missing: reach missing -> predicted from height via a training-only linear fit; height missing -> training median; any remaining NaN -> z = 0 (training mean)
preprocessing.term_scaling: each symbolic term divided by its training-row std (stored with the model)

symbolic_grammar.term_form: T(A,B) = h(a, b) - h(b, a), so every term is exactly antisymmetric under a corner swap
symbolic_grammar.model_form_A: P(A wins) = sigmoid( sum_k w_k * T_k(A,B) ), no intercept
symbolic_grammar.model_form_B: P(A wins) = sigmoid( logit(p_market_A) + sum_k w_k * T_k(A,B) ), no intercept, market coefficient fixed at 1
symbolic_grammar.weight_fit: L2-penalised logistic likelihood, Newton solver, lambda = 1.0 on standardised terms (equivalent to sklearn C = 1)

search.engine: custom bounded genetic programming over sets of antisymmetric terms (research/symbolic/symreg.py)
search.fitness: inner-validation log loss + 0.0002 x total node count

validation.outer_train: eligible rows with event_date in [2008-01-01, Jan 1 of test year)
validation.inner_validation: events in the last two calendar years of the outer training window; inner-train is everything earlier
validation.grouping: split by event date, so no event is ever divided between train and test
validation.selection_rule_A_B: single individual with the lowest penalised inner-validation score across all 15 runs (3 configs x 5 seeds); its structure is then refitted on the full outer-training window and scored once on the test year
validation.experiment_C: L2 logistic on all 23 linear differences plus the distinct terms from the top-5 hall-of-fame models of Experiment A in that fold; C chosen from {0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1,3} by inner-validation log loss
validation.baseline_LR: same as C without discovered terms, same C grid, same selection
validation.baseline_v1_refit: the reported v1 structure sigmoid(w1 z(d_age) + w2 z(d_elo) + w3 z(d_sapm)) refitted per fold on our point-in-time features, no intercept
validation.baseline_v1_reported: the reported v1 coefficients applied to our standardised differences; approximate only, because v1's preprocessing is unavailable
validation.baseline_market: archived consensus probability (timestamps are placeholders: unverified)
validation.baseline_elo: sigmoid(ln10/400 x elo difference), no fitting

evaluation.uncertainty: event-level bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 7, of the log-loss difference vs each baseline
evaluation.headline_window: pooled 2021-2025 outer folds; 2026 reported separately as historical research because CFL has already examined it
evaluation.improvement_rule: a model 'improves' on a baseline only if the 95% event-bootstrap interval of the pooled 2021-2025 log-loss difference excludes zero in its favour AND it wins in at least 4 of the 5 folds
evaluation.verified_market: timing-verified prices exist for 34 decided fights only; reported descriptively, never pooled with archived odds

final_model: the same A/B/C procedure run once on every eligible row through 2026-10-03, inner validation = 2025-2026; frozen by SHA-256 for prospective scoring on events after 2026-10-07
